title: Liftoff from the Festival
summary: The grand festival, once a symbol of hope, now masked drastic unemployment, threatening to unravel the community. A trustworthy soldier was needed to rekindle their spirits, perhaps a freelance jack to navigate the buffoonery and dybbuks. Our protagonist, a determined teenager, found herself in an interrogatory with ancient ents. She wrestled for answers, seeking practical solutions to escape the looping past and avoid the cruel fate of the greedy. An irregularity, a tiny breadcrumb of information, unfroze a critical path forward. With a mighty whacker, she brought forth a powerful processor, enabling a successful liftoff. Her actions transformed the landscape, leaving behind the uncomfy past, ushering in a future filled with happy guffaws and endless possibilities.
protagonist: a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls
